daily_compact_mode.summary: Under the cost-saving daily-compact operating mode (config/scheduled_tasks.json -> operating_mode), weekday tasks suppress no-op / heartbeat notifications and notify ONLY for actionable events. Heavy narrative reporting is deferred to the Friday 5:00 PM ET weekly refresh.
actionable_events: blocked signal-generation entry point (GATE5_DISABLED, seven-slot Claude roster)
daily_compact_mode.actionable_events_note_2026_07_30: GATE5_DISABLED was added as an explicit actionable event on 2026-07-30 alongside claude/dca-executor-prompts/*.txt's Gate 5/Gate 9 alerting fix: that verdict is a known, expected gap (no signal-generation entry point exists yet, see claude/GATE5-PROPOSAL.md) rather than an error in the traditional sense, so it did not already match any entry on this list -- without this addition, an agent following this policy literally could still treat the new Gate 5 alert as a routine/heartbeat notification and suppress it, reproducing the exact silent-executor problem the prompt change was meant to fix (see claude/GATE5-WATCHDOG-FIXES-2026-07-30.md). GATE4_EXPECTED_OVERLAP was added the same day for the same reason: it is likewise a known, expected condition (Gate 4 recognizing the legacy stream's own same-window order) rather than a traditional error, so an agent honoring suppress_no_op_notifications could otherwise discard it as a no-op -- but the 10:30/12:30/3:30 prompts now require all three Gate 9 channels for it too, same as GATE5_DISABLED (see claude/GATE5-WATCHDOG-FIXES-2026-07-30.md's thirteenth revision).

slack.note: No Slack for routine notifications. Explicitly disabled as a default channel.

optional_drift_alert.purpose: Opt-in path for immediate drift alerts from scripts/drift_detection.py only.
optional_drift_alert.secret_policy: The webhook URL is read from the DCA_DRIFT_SLACK_WEBHOOK environment variable (or --slack-webhook) at runtime and is NEVER stored in git or this config. Leave the env var unset to keep Slack off; the detector then falls back to in_app_message_center routing.
optional_drift_alert.enable: Set DCA_DRIFT_SLACK_WEBHOOK in the scheduler environment and pass --slack to the detector.

email.scope: Only where a task explicitly says to email; no routine dashboard emails.

routing_conditions.gate5_disabled_alerts: Added 2026-07-30, when GATE5_DISABLED (the seven-slot Claude roster's blocked-entry-point verdict, see claude/GATE5-WATCHDOG-FIXES-2026-07-30.md) became an actionable, alerting event: each executor prompt's Gate 9 requires all three of IN-APP MESSAGE CENTER, REPO ALERT FILE, and EMAIL DRAFT for that verdict specifically. Deliberately a SEPARATE route from live_run_alerts, not a widening of it: live_run_alerts is shared by every live-run alert category, including the five currently-live legacy tasks, and channels.email.scope/docs/safeguards.md are explicit that email is sent only where a task explicitly requests it -- unconditionally adding email to the shared route would have emailed on every legacy live-run alert too, not just this one verdict. The REPO ALERT FILE channel is not one of this file's three channels (slack/in_app_message_center/email) and is not routed through this table at all -- it is written directly by the executor to dca_paths.stream_root(...) as described in each prompt's Gate 9, a durable-fallback mechanism this config has no representation for.
routing_conditions.gate4_expected_overlap_alerts: Added 2026-07-30 (same day as gate5_disabled_alerts, thirteenth revision of claude/GATE5-WATCHDOG-FIXES-2026-07-30.md), when GATE4_EXPECTED_OVERLAP -- the 10:30/12:30/3:30 Claude slots' classification for a same-window order recognized as the legacy morning-dca-/midday-dca-/graded-dca- stream, not a rogue second executor -- stopped ending those fires silently. Mirrors gate5_disabled_alerts exactly: a SEPARATE route from live_run_alerts for the same email-scoping reason (channels.email.scope/docs/safeguards.md), and the REPO ALERT FILE channel is likewise written directly by the executor per Gate 9, not represented in this table.
routing_conditions.capital_priority_briefing: Notify (in-app + email) only if at least one ticker triggers a 1.5x or higher multiplier; otherwise silent.
routing_conditions.premarket_buying_power: Analytics dashboard only; no routine notification.
routing_conditions.volatility_outliers: Alert only for >5% outliers or actionable errors.
routing_conditions.drift_alerts: Fire an IMMEDIATE alert when scripts/drift_detection.py detects an auto-buy signal (auto_buy_signal true and incremental_order_amount > 0 or desired amount > 0) with no corresponding submitted-order record. Routes to in_app_message_center by default; also posts to Slack when DCA_DRIFT_SLACK_WEBHOOK is set and the detector is run with --slack. Never routine/heartbeat -- only on detected drift.
routing_conditions.month_end_volatility_risk: Month-end volatility risk refresh (tasks c9fb1fb8/17a3b2a9, see month_end_volatility_risk_policy in config/scheduled_tasks.json). Notify (in-app + email) ONLY if the Notion refresh fails, data quality blocks the run, or one or more tickers triggered the 3x tier more than twice; otherwise silent. Email subject: 'Month-end DCA volatility risk table'. No Slack. The run also ends silently with no notification when the final-eligible-market-day gate does not pass.
routing_conditions.daily_compact_mode: Weekday daily tasks suppress no-op/heartbeat notifications and notify only for the actionable events listed in daily_compact_mode.actionable_events (placed/rejected orders, budget-capped candidates, missing/invalid artifacts, broker/log mismatch, data-confidence failures, drift-detector failures, recovery attempts/failures, meaningful exceptions, blocked signal-generation entry point / GATE5_DISABLED for the seven-slot Claude roster, expected legacy-stream overlap / GATE4_EXPECTED_OVERLAP for the 10:30/12:30/3:30 Claude slots). Full narrative/dashboard reporting is deferred to the Friday weekly refresh (041d9d90).
